task.description: Autoregressive token generation for fixed Qwen3.8 Flash Next model (qwen4exp_tp5_af)
task.timing_scope: Steady-state decode phase per delivered public token; excludes prefill and cold setup
task.start_state: Fixed prompt context H and KV/GDN cache state S at token boundary; stateful causal evolution without pre-solved answers

timing.hardware_boundary: Wall-clock time between the commitment of token n-1 and token n across all 5 RX 6800 ranks
timing.latency_definition: T(a) = infimum wall-clock elapsed time required by implementation a to produce the valid token distribution

start_state_causality.prohibition_of_answer_caching: Evaluation is over arbitrary prompt completions; caching precomputed output tokens trivially violates semantic generalization.
start_state_causality.precomputation_displacement: Moving prompt/state precomputation to S requires S to be strictly derived from the causal prefix. Offline weight transformations are allowed if within storage/initial fast capacity constraints, but cannot pre-evaluate inputs.

quantifiers_and_families.inf_over_allowed: T* = inf { T(a) : a in A }, where A is the set of all mathematically correct implementations preserving quality/semantic contract.

branch_aggregation.same_branch_resource_overlap: T(a) >= max_k (W_k(a) / C_k) unless non-overlap is rigorously proved, in which case sum_k is permitted.
branch_aggregation.cross_branch_relaxation: Global lower bound L_global = inf_{a in A} T(a) <= min_{family F} inf_{a in F} T(a). To prove L_global > c, one must prove T(a) > c for EVERY valid family F.

standard_tp_dense_read.work_lower_bound: W_mem >= distinct_required_weights. Stated as 4,614,087,680 bytes of unique encoded tensor data across the active path.
standard_tp_dense_read.work_proof_status: UNRESOLVED (as a universal lower bound; proved only for explicit tabular dense weight access without algorithmic compression/reconstruction).
standard_tp_dense_read.capacity_source: AMD Radeon RX 6800 peak theoretical bandwidth: 5 * 512 GB/s = 2560 GB/s (https://www.amd.com/en/products/graphics/desktops/radeon/6000-series/amd-radeon-rx-6800.html).
standard_tp_dense_read.capacity_proof_status: PROVED as theoretical peak envelope (not sustained measured ~390 GB/s).

fused_and_repartitioned_compute.work_lower_bound: Work depends on arithmetic complexity of attention/GDN/MoE projections. Replicated vs partitioned execution.
fused_and_repartitioned_compute.work_proof_status: UNRESOLVED. E.g. f(x;W) replicated across 5 ranks requires 5x work; computing once and broadcasting changes work/comm trade-off.
fused_and_repartitioned_compute.capacity_source: RX 6800 FP32 peak compute: 16.17 TFLOP/s per card = 80.85 TFLOP/s aggregate.

coordinate_partition_latebind_hc.work_lower_bound: In current LateBind, Q_b and rho_b are partitioned along coordinate axis R=320, requiring 4 streams * 320 floats communication.
coordinate_partition_latebind_hc.work_proof_status: UNRESOLVED as an information-theoretic necessity; it is an artifact of the specific coordinate-split low-rank residual projection.
coordinate_partition_latebind_hc.capacity_source: PCIe / Host relay / DMA-buf transfer bandwidth.

speculative_mtp.work_lower_bound: Amortized cost per public token: cycle_ms / k_accepted_tokens.
speculative_mtp.work_proof_status: UNRESOLVED. Cannot bound below non-speculative step if speculative acceptance rate k > 1 amortizes cycle cost.

claim_4x320_communication.description: Claim that 4x320 communication (or equivalent byte volume) is mandatory for LateBind HC fold.
claim_4x320_communication.counterexample_and_refutation: The 4x320 payload is strictly tied to coordinate-wise partitioning of the low-rank intermediate (width R=320, 4 residual streams). An alternative implementation could compute the low-rank projection centrally on one rank after gathering intermediate scalar state, or project using an alternate orthogonal basis, or fuse the down-projection with the up-projection if weights/memory allow, requiring 0 cross-rank Q_b transmission.
claim_4x320_communication.status: UNRESOLVED (Construction artifact, not information-theoretic cut-set lower bound)

claim_mandatory_weight_io.description: Claim that 4.614 GB (or 1.869 GB per-rank) must cross DRAM boundary every token.
claim_mandatory_weight_io.counterexample_and_refutation: Pigeonhole lemma only establishes max(0, U - C) bytes where C is initial fast capacity (SRAM/LDS/L1/L2/Infinity Cache). Furthermore, no proof exists that the trained matrix representations are incompressibly minimal in the information-theoretic sense.

trivial_global_lower_bound.scope: Universal across all possible valid algorithms A without restriction on precomputation/representation
trivial_global_lower_bound.limitations: Trivial lower bound L=0. In the absence of an information-theoretic certificate proving that the output cannot be computed with sub-linear representation or speculative skip, no positive non-trivial global bound is certified.

conditional_io_lower_bound.scope: CONDITIONAL ONLY: Assumes exactly 4,614,087,680 incompressible original weight bytes must be streamed from DRAM with 0 initial fast cache state across 5 * 512 GB/s channels.
conditional_io_lower_bound.limitations: Fails if weights are cached in fast SRAM/Infinity Cache, pruned/compressed losslessly, or if multi-token speculative reuse amortizes reads.

largest_unexcluded_branch.family: Speculative multi-token decoding (MTP) with fused zero-communication coordinate representations and fast-cache weight retention
largest_unexcluded_branch.note: Null. No finite universal upper bound on TPS (or non-zero lower bound on latency) can be certified without closing the MTP acceptance and representation compression branches.
